notes:
Manafall 0.1.32 - Windows client

Online and host
- Online -> Host opens server options (name, player limit, password, public list) instead of bouncing to the main menu.
- Host and clients share the same day/night clock.
- Public server list works when the game port answers (NAT / port 7777 on many networks).

Client play
- Harvest, hit markers, and loot feel more reliable on clients.
- Disconnect -> main menu -> rehost should clean up more cleanly.

Sky and calendar
- Gradual dusk colors; visible sun, moon, and stars; occasional northern lights.
- Calendar year 117, 13 old Roman months, Latin weekdays.
- Hills can shade trees and rocks from the sun.

Fire
- Building fire spread respects rain soak.
- Fire spells can ignite wood (roughly 8-92% chance by spell).

Patcher
- Keeps a partial download; only installs a full matching client zip.
- Auto-update downloads three parts. Leave ~4 GB free on your Windows drive.
